Oofuna Warrior"And my enemies, equally useless! One brush of my armoured sleeve and finished? Have some shame!"
Oofuna Warrior"I am Heihachirou Asahina of Oyumi! Thirtieth in the line of the great Yatarou Asahina! This battle that decides the realm—I have chosen it as my place to die!"
Oofuna Warrior"A worthy enemy, come forward! Take my head, make your name!"
